blurb: Guests paddle down the Colorado River experiencing views of Horseshoe Bend, Vermilion Cliffs, wild horses, and ancient petroglyphs. The trip is customizable with various drop-off points along the river. They offer backhaul services transporting guests upstream from Lees Ferry Boat Launch and a variety of boat rentals including hardshell kayaks, inflatable kayaks, SUPs, and canoes.
